sourceChecks.text: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

profileDecisionJa: ベケルの子らの名簿に名が現れます。固定WEBの綴りは「Zemirah」です。
